title: New book published
text: Distributed Systems Thinking: Architectural Judgment for the AI-Assisted Engineer is now available. Built from the COMP41720 masters module at UCD, it argues that AI has made implementation cheap and left architectural judgment as the part an engineer still has to do.

title: Three new books published
text: Maths for Quantum Computing and Maths for AI (the first two volumes of the Mathematics for Everything series), and Six Ideas That Run the World, are now available.

title: Two papers at IEEE WCNC 2026
text: Work on finite-regime QKD entropy analysis and Grover-inspired quantum reinforcement learning for massive MIMO scheduling presented at WCNC 2026.

title: New journal papers
text: Papers published in IEEE Transactions on Green Communications and Networking and the Journal of Lightwave Technology on hybrid quantum-classical optical networks.

title: Promoted to Associate Professor
text: Appointed Associate Professor in the School of Computer Science at University College Dublin.

title: Horizon Europe grant
text: Awarded €216,028 as part of the QUADRATURE project on scalable multi-chip quantum architectures (2023–2027).

title: New modules
text: Now coordinating Team Software Project, Distributed Systems, and Software Engineering at UCD.
